_provenance.note: Hand-written to match the schema produced by cellforge/Method_Design/refinement.py. Content grounded in arXiv:2508.02276. See ../PROVENANCE.md.

model_architecture.name: CPA-X
model_architecture.rationale: The unseen-perturbation split is the binding constraint. A free per-perturbation embedding table cannot satisfy it, because rows for held-out perturbations never receive gradient. Conditioning on the target gene's embedding, and tying that embedding to the decoder output weights, means every gene is trained by every reconstruction and a held-out target still has a meaningful representation at test time.

gene_embedding.purpose: single shared representation used both to condition the perturbation and to decode expression

perturbation_encoder.combination: sum over targets, which also covers combinatorial perturbations
perturbation_encoder.control_behaviour: zero vector; controls need no embedding

components.composition: additive in latent space: z_basal + z_perturbation

adversary.purpose: trained to recover the perturbation from the basal latent; the encoder is trained to defeat it

feature_selection.constraint: perturbation target genes are forced into the retained set regardless of variance rank, since the model conditions on the target's embedding

label_parsing.convention: TARGET+ctrl for single, TARGET_A+TARGET_B for combinatorial

training_strategy.objective: MSE reconstruction loss minus adv_weight * adversary cross-entropy
training_strategy.expected_runtime: 4-8 hours on one GPU for the full dataset

evaluation_metrics.primary: DE-restricted metrics; genome-wide figures are dominated by the unperturbed baseline and are sanity checks rather than results
evaluation_metrics.aggregation: perturbation-centric: score each perturbation once, then average over perturbations
evaluation_metrics.known_metric_behaviour: R2_DE can legitimately be negative: the DE subset is selected for having moved and therefore has low residual variance.

acceptance_criteria: python result.py --help exits 0 without third-party dependencies installed
metrics.json parses as a JSON object and contains model, dataset, split, metrics, per_perturbation, de_definition, averaging
implementation_details.determinism: fixed seed controls data generation, splitting, initialisation, and batching
implementation_details.dependency_policy: torch, numpy and anndata imported lazily inside the functions that need them, so --help and --selftest work in a bare interpreter

estimator.definition: prediction = observed control mean + mean(decode(z+p) - decode(z))
estimator.rationale: decoding the same basal latent with and without the perturbation isolates the shift and cancels systematic reconstruction bias, which would otherwise contaminate every gene and swamp the comparatively small differential signal
